subject.title: fix(memory): fall back to keyword search without sqlite

question: Should OpenClaw accept degraded keyword search rows when `node:sqlite` is unavailable, or keep the shipped remediation-only unavailable result?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but repository policy treats fallback behavior as a product decision and this changes the user-visible result shape for an existing failure path.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now and let maintainers reopen or sponsor a replacement only after choosing the fallback behavior and scan bounds.

options.title: Sponsor Degraded Recall
options.body: Accept `keyword-fallback` semantics for the missing-`node:sqlite` path and proceed with maintainer review of this branch as the closing implementation.

options.title: Require Bounds First
options.body: Ask for explicit file, byte, or timeout bounds before accepting per-search markdown scanning as an availability tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and let maintainers reopen or sponsor a replacement only after choosing the fallback behavior and scan bounds.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently authored the shipped remediation-only `node:sqlite` guidance path and are the strongest current-history owner for deciding whether OpenClaw should go beyond that behavior.
